name: Context Fidelity Index
measurement_target: Judge-rated maintenance of conversation context in a response
observable: Response text relative to the provided conversation history (last 10 messages, i.e. ~5 exchanges), as rated by an LLM judge
instrument: LLM-as-judge, rubric fingerprint SCORING_PROMPT_HASH, 0-100 sub-scores combined by fixed weights

context_retention.observes: incorporation of prior context, as judged

topic_drift.observes: topical coherence with the conversation flow (100 = on-topic), as judged

coherence_loss.observes: degradation of logical coherence (100 = fully coherent), as judged

theory_inspiration: Context-window degradation literature (inspiration only, not an implementation): no planted-fact recall is measured yet — deterministic planted-fact checks are the roadmap replacement
allowed_claims: Response X maintains its provided history better than response Y, as judged, under configuration Z
Within one fixed configuration, CFI drops are a usable drift tripwire (see examples/support-drift-monitor)
prohibited_claims: The system remembers / understands the conversation (CFI observes textual consistency, not memory mechanisms)
Cross-configuration comparisons of absolute CFI values
known_confounds: Only the last 10 history messages (~5 exchanges) are shown to the judge — long-range fidelity is unobserved
Judge-relative scale; a fluent response can paper over a contradiction (Run 001: fluent self-contradiction composite 41.4 vs 40 under GPT-4o)
positive_controls: none designed-high specifically for CFI yet — a planted-fact recall item is the roadmap addition
statistics: mean over n samples; Bessel-corrected SD; Student-t CI at n>=2; no significance claims at current sample sizes

validity_evidence.content: facets cover retention/drift/coherence; no expert panel yet
validity_evidence.criterion: sensitivity check (Run 001): the designed context-abandonment benchmark item scored composite 12.2/20.2 against its max bound of 40 under both judges — deliberate drift is detected. Not a positive control (designed-low item)
validity_evidence.reliability: composite-level H2 (median sample SD 1.79/2.19 within judge); post-hoc per-dimension CFI median sample SD from Run 001 raw records: 2.88 / 5.64 — the NOISIEST dimension under gpt-4o

validity_domain: English conversations up to ~10 visible turns; two commercial judge families tested
